description: This file defines a custom exception class 'PublicKeyProviderUnavailableException' used within a security/authentication context of a gateway service. The class extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'GatewayException', providing details and builder methods for an exception indicating the public key provider is unavailable.

classes.name: PublicKeyProviderUnavailableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception indicating the public key provider is unavailable, with support for JSON deserialization and header management.
